entries.dataTransport: Yahoo Finance hourly frozen V3 files
entries.interpretation: Entry mechanic alone is not the root cause. The generic candidate/setup architecture plus frozen stop/target/management stack has negative absolute expectancy across all three entry modes. structure_confirmed_retest improved candidate utility versus trigger_close with bootstrap support but remained absolutely negative and lost too much recall.
entries.contaminationRule: The E1-V3 development outcomes may be used only for diagnosis and hypothesis generation. They may not be reused as fresh proof for a redesigned architecture.

entries.interpretation: A1 materially improved candidate-level utility versus the frozen E1 generic baseline, but absolute expectancy remained negative, robustness failed, precision/recall failed, and only one market family was positive. This proves that improved payoff geometry and trend alignment alone are insufficient.
entries.contaminationRule: A1 fresh-instrument outcomes are now contaminated and may be used only for diagnosis/hypothesis generation. They cannot be reused as fresh proof for B1/C1 or any later architecture.

entries.interpretation: B1 strongly reduced exposure relative to the generic sweep/reclaim baseline and improved candidate utility, but it became too sparse, missed almost all audited good reference opportunities, and remained negative in absolute expectancy. Range-neutrality plus reclaim geometry is therefore not sufficient as a standalone broad cross-market engine.
entries.contaminationRule: B1 outcomes are contaminated and may be used only for diagnosis. No B1 subgroup or threshold may be promoted.

nextAuthorizedResearch: C1 remains the sole untested prelocked price-pattern architecture. If C1 fails, activate the finite-budget terminal stop rule and do not launch another price-pattern family in ITE1.
forbidden: opening prior fresh validation as a rescue sample without explicit reclassification and loss of validation status
